_comment: Single source of truth for every number the public site asserts. Pages carry data-fact="<key>" spans; scripts/site_facts.py verifies each one against this file and CI fails on drift. Add a fact here before quoting it on a page. Numbers that belong to one measured run carry that run's snapshot id, because a fact without a snapshot cannot be re-checked.

registry-v2-10m-3sys.note: PostgreSQL's 10M column is a July measurement carried forward, marked in the table.

registry_queries.prose: registry queries, each answered by every system and hash-verified before timing

system_count.prose: systems answering the same registry: TGMS native, TGMS-on-DuckDB, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Neo4j, Memgraph

coverage_current.prose: of 110 independently written questions expressible in the current operator set

coverage_original.prose: of 110 expressible in the pre-registered 13-operator study (D-026, July 2026)

storage_bytes_per_row.prose: bytes per edge version, segments after compaction and generation collection, at 1M rows

storage_whole_store_bytes_per_row.prose: bytes per edge version for the whole store after generation collection

memory_10m_suite.prose: GB peak RSS for the full 10M query suite under a 2 GB cap

traversal_200k_graph_engines.prose: seconds for the same reachability query on Memgraph and Neo4j

clickhouse_agg_lead_10m.prose: times faster than TGMS on whole-window aggregation at 10M (40.0 vs 183.7 ms)
clickhouse_agg_lead_10m.history: 12x, then 8.7x after the D-044 refresh, then 4.6x after the D-046 scan work

agg_native_lead_200k.prose: times faster than ClickHouse on grouped aggregation at 200k (14.5 vs 32.6 ms)

reproducibility_band.prose: percent - single latency cells reproduce to about this band between days on the measurement host

unsupported_claims.prose: unsupported claims among the 268 evaluated answers of the dev-split campaign
unsupported_claims.scope_required: must be stated with its denominator, never as a universal guarantee

unsupported_claims_denominator.prose: evaluated answers behind the 0 unsupported claims figure
unsupported_claims_denominator.scope_required: unsupported_claims must never appear without this number beside it
unsupported_claims_denominator.review: paper/main.tex reports the frozen campaign as 282 task runs, 270 measurable, 220 ungated-emitted and 0 of 199 gated-emitted; 268 traces only to paper/REVIEW_RESPONSE.md. Denominator and split label both need the author's adjudication.

answer_accuracy_tgms.prose: percent of tasks whose structured answer exactly matched the reference (pooled, Qwen2.5-14B)

series_10m_clickhouse_ms.prose: ms, the same query on ClickHouse

point_lookup_200k_native_ms.prose: ms, entity history by identity at 200k

point_lookup_200k_postgres_ms.prose: ms, the same lookup on PostgreSQL with a covering index

motif_200k_graph_engines.prose: seconds for the same motif on Memgraph and Neo4j

storage_duckdb_bytes_per_row.prose: bytes per relationship version on DuckDB for the same 1M event log, uncompressed columnar, no secondary indexes

storage_clickhouse_bytes_per_row.prose: bytes per relationship version on ClickHouse, lz4 MergeTree, no secondary indexes

storage_postgres_bytes_per_row.prose: bytes per relationship version on PostgreSQL including the eight covering indexes its lookup speed is made of

scan_10m_parallel_null_before_ms.prose: ms, the 10M scan before materialization was parallelised

scan_10m_parallel_null_after_ms.prose: ms, the same scan after parallel materialization landed - the null result that started the probe

scan_10m_clusterwise_ms.prose: ms, the same scan once selections were merged cluster-wise so the parallel path could fire

series_10m_clusterwise_ms.prose: ms, series.count at 10M immediately after cluster-wise merging - an August 2026 waypoint, not the current figure; later projection work took the same query to 183.7 ms

append_batch1000_ev_s.prose: events per second on sustained appends at batch size 1000; the same durable commit floor gives 96 ev/s at batch 1

correction_latency_p50_ms.prose: ms median for a single-operation correction against a 100k-row store

correction_growth_kb.prose: KB of store growth per single-op correction, almost all of it a fresh full manifest rather than the corrected data

compaction_100k_s.prose: seconds to compact a 100k-row store with 250 corrections folded, 253 segments to 2, answer digest preserved

warmup_first_query_10m_s.prose: seconds for the first query in a fresh process against a 10M store - the in-memory warm-up, paid whatever the query asks for

warmup_first_query_1m_s.prose: seconds for the first query in a fresh process against a 1M store

resident_index_tax_pct.prose: percent that an unrelated scan slows by while the traversal index built by an earlier query stays resident in the same process

betweenday_drift_pct.prose: percent drift on scan-bound queries when the same commits are re-measured on a later day - distinct from the resident-index tax, and the reason the published band is 20 percent

resident_probe_nothing_ms.prose: ms, series.count at 1M with nothing resident

resident_probe_plain_columns_ms.prose: ms, the same query while 1M rows of plain integer columns are held

resident_probe_index_columns_ms.prose: ms, the same query while the traversal index's own source columns are held

resident_probe_index_built_ms.prose: ms, the same query while the built traversal index is held - the 18 percent

resident_probe_released_ms.prose: ms, the same query after the index is released - the time comes back

parallel_gate_ab_default_ms.prose: ms, series.count at 1M with the scan-parallelism gate at its default - the reading that would not reproduce

parallel_gate_ab_forced_ms.prose: ms, the same query with the parallel path forced on - the hypothesis measured false

series_1m_july_published_ms.prose: ms, the July 2026 published figure for series.count at 1M that a later run could not reproduce

bisect_builds.prose: engine builds bisected, one 1M run each, to locate the step change

dev_task_count.prose: development-split tasks every system answers under identical models, seeds, temperature 0 and repair budget

dev_probe_task_count.prose: of the development tasks are correction probes: the same question asked of the belief before a correction and of the belief after it

answer_accuracy_cypher_dev.prose: percent typed-answer accuracy for text-to-Cypher over the same events in a plain property graph (dev split)

answer_accuracy_vector_rag_dev.prose: percent typed-answer accuracy for vector-RAG over serialised events (dev split)

answer_accuracy_static_rag_dev.prose: percent typed-answer accuracy for static-graph RAG over the latest snapshot (dev split)

probe_accuracy_tgms_dev.prose: percent typed-answer accuracy on the correction probes, TGMS, Qwen2.5-14B (2 of 3 dev probe tasks)
probe_accuracy_tgms_dev.scope_required: 3 tasks; state the count beside the percentage

probe_accuracy_baselines_dev.prose: percent typed-answer accuracy on the correction probes for all three baselines at 14B on the dev split
probe_accuracy_baselines_dev.scope_required: dev split only; on the frozen split vector-RAG scores 15.4 percent on CollegeMsg probes, from current-belief halves

exec_success_probes_before.prose: percent execution success on the 3 dev correction-probe tasks with output-field validation disabled (0 of 3), Qwen2.5-7B

exec_success_probes_after.prose: percent execution success on the same 3 tasks with output-field validation enabled (3 of 3), Qwen2.5-7B
exec_success_probes_after.scope_required: 3 tasks, execution success only - never state as overall system accuracy

exec_success_overall_before.prose: percent execution success across all 22 dev tasks before output contracts (0 of 22)

exec_success_overall_after.prose: percent execution success across all 22 dev tasks after output contracts (12 of 22)

plan_validity_7b.prose: percent of first-emitted plans that pass validation at Qwen2.5-7B on the dev split

plan_validity_14b.prose: percent of first-emitted plans that pass validation at Qwen2.5-14B on the dev split

default_page_limit.prose: rows returned by default from any paginated operator, maximum 10,000

incident_page_rows.prose: rows on the page the model counted during the D-015 live demo

incident_total_rows.prose: rows the complete result actually held during the D-015 live demo

mutation_truncated_cases.prose: generated correct-arithmetic-over-truncated-evidence cases, all refused full support when completeness propagation is on

mutation_truncated_without_taint.prose: of the 15 truncated-page counts are caught when completeness propagation is disabled

mutation_belief_cases.prose: wrong-belief-state cases, all detected by re-checking claims against the transaction time the trace was pinned to

mutation_uncited_entity_cases.prose: cases adding a real entity the cited evidence never mentioned, all detected

mutation_unit_confusion_cases.prose: cases reading microseconds as milliseconds, all detected

mutation_member_dropped_cases.prose: cases dropping a member from a reported entity set

mutation_member_dropped_detected.prose: of the dropped-member cases are detected - under-claiming is invisible to trace grounding by construction

mutation_clean_pool.prose: clean answers in the database-semantics pool, on which the checks raised no false positives

accuracy_ungated.prose: percent typed-answer accuracy with claim gating off

accuracy_gated.prose: percent typed-answer accuracy with claim gating on - the cost of the gate is this one point
